g.text: Floor +0.00 m. Nominal clear height 2.3 m. Room sizes
give the bounding spans in metres.
The pilot steps into a transverse dispatch room. A sliding freight door opens onto two sled rails. The starboard side
hatch loads the hold directly, and a separate crew lift rises into the hump.
